_comment: Level virtuals on 1.26.51.1 from Endstone's ILevel/Level header order anchored on the confirmed slots (docs/findings-slots.md, route 9): between header slot 0 and 380 every confirmed name sits one slot above its header index (getDifficulty 36, getBlockPalette 86, getStructureManager 96, tick 119, getSeed 134, setDefaultSpawn 137, getLevelData 172, getActorFactory 288, getGameRules 342/343, getScoreboard 361 on 1.26.40.8), so the names in that region are read at header+1 and nothing outside it. The region first stopped at 288 on a wrong anchor: slot 348, shipped as getGameRules, is getDefaultAbilities (docs/findings-slots.md). Second route: the other 1.26 build, with its own header revision, puts every one of these at the same live slot with the same function size. Never hook targets from this file: save fired once at stop and getDifficulty returned the difficulty on 1.26.40.8 (data/resolved); levelCleanupQueueEntityRemoval did not fire under a pig kill and stays a call-only name. getTime/setTime are left out: an earlier execution found getTime not a pure slot of this table. 2026-09-19: the region below 35 was never wrong, only unchecked: the header's pairs (forEachDimension 8/9, getDimensionManager 10/11, getCameraPresets 29/30) are the live table's same-function pairs and get/setDisablePlayerInteractions are the byte getter and setter on one offset at 32/33.
